optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample establish the candidate’s experience managing a mobile payments backlog, writing compliance‑aligned user stories, achieving measurable funnel improvements, conducting sprint reviews and usability sessions, and integrating a name‑checking service.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to assess fit.

evidence.text: Managed the backlog for the payments squad of Thistle Credit Union's mobile app, refining stories each week with the four engineers and the tester.
Wrote the user stories for the new add-payee journey with the compliance officer, including acceptance criteria for the warning shown when a payee name does not match the account.

After the add-payee journey was rebuilt, the share of add-payee attempts abandoned before confirmation fell from 23.5% (January to March 2024) to 12.9% (May to July 2024), measured with the analytics events defined in the tracking plan.
Ran fortnightly sprint reviews and three moderated usability sessions with members recruited through the member panel.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of sprint reviews and usability sessions.

evidence.text: Worked with the integration partner to connect the name-checking service and to test its match and no-match responses before the April 2024 release.
evidence.notes: Shows experience with name‑checking service integration.

humanReviewChecklist: Verify that the candidate’s backlog refinement activities included all squad members.
Confirm the scope of compliance requirements addressed in the user stories.
Ensure the funnel improvement metrics were derived from the same tracking plan used in the job.
Clarify the nature of the usability sessions (moderated vs. unmoderated).
Discuss the integration details of the name‑checking service, including handling of close‑match results.
hiringEvidencePacket.auditSummary: All five job requirements are directly supported by evidence from the candidate’s resume and work sample. The evidence demonstrates backlog management, compliance‑aligned user story creation, measurable funnel improvement, sprint review and usability facilitation, and name‑checking service integration. No gaps or unsupported claims were identified.
limitations: No evidence of production‑level deployment or cross‑functional leadership beyond the payments squad.
No explicit mention of handling close‑match results in the name‑checking service integration.
